title: Engineering carboxyl methyltransferase for high-efficiency biosynthesis of methyl salicylate in Escherichia coli.
authors: Gao, Yuan; Guo, Shibo; Wu, Jun; Wang, Jingyan; Liu, Huan; Guo, Jimin; Sun, Xinxiao; Wang, Jia; Shen, Xiaolin; Yuan, Qipeng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过融合蛋白设计改造羧甲基转移酶并利用分子动力学模拟解析多组氨酸标签增强催化效率的机制，虽以酶工程和代谢工程为核心，但MD模拟涉及蛋白质结构-功能关系，对蛋白结构计算研究有一定参考价值。
abstract: Methyl salicylate (MeSA) is a volatile methylated aromatic ester widely used in agriculture, food, and pharmaceuticals. Microbial biosynthesis offers a sustainable alternative to plant extraction and petrochemical synthesis; however, efficient MeSA production remains limited by the low catalytic efficiency of carboxyl methyltransferases, insufficient intracellular supply of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM), and severe product volatilization during fermentation. In this study, we systematically screened salicylate carboxymethyltransferase and identified CbSAMT as a relatively efficient catalyst for salicylic acid (SA). To further improve catalytic performance, we engineered CbSAMT through fusion-protein design. Remarkably, the catalytic efficiency of 7 x His-CbSAMT was 12-fold higher than that of the wild-type. Molecular dynamics simulations and computational analyses revealed that the polyhistidine tag reshaped the catalytic microenvironment by remodeling the hydrogen-bonding network and reducing the distance between SA and key substrate-positioning residues, thereby enhancing substrate binding and catalytic turnover. To further enhance MeSA biosynthesis, we reinforced intracellular SAM regeneration and established an in situ two-phase fermentation system using n-dodecane as the extractant to alleviate product volatilization. Finally, fed-batch fermentation achieved a MeSA titer of 5.12 g/L, representing the highest production level reported to date. Collectively, this study highlights the potential of polyhistidine tags in enzyme engineering and provides an efficient platform for the biosynthesis of volatile methylated natural products.
abstract_zh: 水杨酸甲酯（MeSA）是一种挥发性甲基化芳香酯，广泛应用于农业、食品和制药领域。微生物生物合成提供了一种可持续的替代植物提取和石油化工合成的方法；然而，高效的MeSA生产仍受限于羧基甲基转移酶的低催化效率、细胞内S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）供应不足，以及发酵过程中严重的产物挥发。在本研究中，我们系统筛选了水杨酸羧基甲基转移酶，并鉴定出CbSAMT作为水杨酸（SA）的相对高效催化剂。为进一步提升催化性能，我们通过融合蛋白设计对CbSAMT进行了工程改造。值得注意的是，7 x His-CbSAMT的催化效率比野生型高出12倍。分子动力学模拟和计算分析揭示，多组氨酸标签通过重塑氢键网络并缩短SA与关键底物定位残基之间的距离，重构了催化微环境，从而增强了底物结合和催化周转。为进一步提高MeSA生物合成，我们强化了细胞内SAM再生，并建立了以正十二烷为萃取剂的原位两相发酵系统，以缓解产物挥发。最终，补料分批发酵实现了5.12 g/L的MeSA滴度，代表了迄今报道的最高生产水平。总体而言，本研究凸显了多组氨酸标签在酶工程中的潜力，并为挥发性甲基化天然产物的生物合成提供了高效平台。
